about.companyIntro: ZeroAnt Technology is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production, and sales of micro-logistics intelligent conveying systems. We are committed to connecting professional equipment and application scenarios through innovative intelligent logistics solutions, helping various industries achieve efficient and reliable intelligent upgrades. Our core team consists of researchers from Beihang University and industry experts, with profound technical expertise and rich engineering experience.
about.culture: Driven by innovation, extremely reliable, and win-win cooperation. We insist on customer-centricity, continuously promote technological innovation, and strive to become a leader in the field of micro-logistics intelligence.
about.jobs: ZeroAnt Technology welcomes outstanding talents who are interested in intelligent logistics and robotics to join us! Please send your resume to hr@zeroant.com.

roboticsEngineer.title: Robotics Engineer
roboticsEngineer.req1: Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Automation or related fields
roboticsEngineer.req2: 3+ years of experience in robotics system development
roboticsEngineer.req3: Familiar with ROS, motion control, path planning technologies

softwareEngineer.title: Software Engineer
softwareEngineer.req1: Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or related fields
softwareEngineer.req2: Proficient in C++, Python and other programming languages
softwareEngineer.req3: Experience in embedded systems or real-time system development
softwareEngineer.req4: Knowledge of robot operating systems and control algorithms

algorithmEngineer.title: Algorithm Engineer
algorithmEngineer.req1: Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Mathematics, Automation or related fields
algorithmEngineer.req2: Experience in deep learning, computer vision or SLAM algorithms
algorithmEngineer.req3: Familiar with TensorFlow, PyTorch and other deep learning frameworks
algorithmEngineer.req4: Experience in robot perception and decision algorithms preferred

hardwareEngineer.title: Hardware Engineer
hardwareEngineer.req1: Bachelor's degree or above in Electronic Engineering, Automation or related fields
hardwareEngineer.req2: Familiar with circuit design, PCB layout and hardware debugging
hardwareEngineer.req3: Experience in embedded system hardware development
hardwareEngineer.req4: Knowledge of sensor integration and signal processing technologies
